arguments.label: Inspect rows.json
arguments.command: cd /workspace/task && ls -la scratch/ && head -c 2000 scratch/rows.json && echo && md5sum scratch/rows.json

cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import json
rows=json.load(open('scratch/rows.json',encoding='utf-8'))
ids=sorted([r['id'] for r in rows if 'note' in r and r['note'] is None])
open('scratch/null-notes.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(ids,ensure_ascii=False))
print(ids)
" && cat scratch/null-notes.json && echo && md5sum scratch/rows.json
